briefing.headline: Nvidia shares fell again this week after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, while AI and chip stocks stayed under pressure.

points.text: Nvidia's board voted to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO. The stock closed up 31% that day, per one video report.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell on Nov 25 as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks.
points.label: reported

points.text: New US tariff proposals on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU, were announced. They target excess capacity.
points.label: reported

points.text: Governance critics say the Huang return was a mistake. Some say it raises scrutiny, including possible congressional investigations.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Nvidia is heading for its first 'death cross' since March 2025, a bearish chart signal.
